scope.flow: TrustBonding first-claim utilization ratio computation in _getPersonalUtilizationRatio

entities.name: new user staking TRUST passively without MultiVault interaction

statements.text: A new user stakes TRUST purely for yield and does not interact with the MultiVault.
The new passive user attempts to make their first claim.
For the new passive user's first epoch, rawUtilizationDelta mathematically evaluates to 0.
The first claim invokes _getPersonalUtilizationRatio, which computes rawUtilizationDelta = userUtilizationAfter - userUtilizationBefore.
The function evaluates the strict penalty check rawUtilizationDelta <= 0 before the first-claim exemption check.
Because 0 <= 0 is true, the function returns early with personalUtilizationLowerBound and never reaches the exemption block.

An execution ordering error in _getPersonalUtilizationRatio places the rawUtilizationDelta <= 0 penalty check before the userUtilizationTarget == 0 first-claim exemption check, making the exemption unreachable for passive stakers.
The new passive user's first-claim yield is slashed to personalUtilizationLowerBound (default 2500, or 25%).
Up to 75% of the new passive user's first epoch matured yield is permanently destroyed.

A user with nothing claimable in the prior epoch (userUtilizationTarget == 0) should be exempt from the utilization penalty on their first ever claim and receive BASIS_POINTS_DIVISOR rather than personalUtilizationLowerBound.
The exemption applies when the user had nothing claimable last epoch, i.e. _userEligibleRewardsForEpoch(_account, _epoch - 1) == 0.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether the first-claim exemption's _userEligibleRewardsForEpoch(_account, _epoch - 1) == 0 condition holds for the described passive user; only the userUtilizationTarget == 0 branch is discussed.
The 75% figure is derived from the 25% lower bound; report does not give explicit numeric expected-versus-actual yield values.
No explicit unauthorized-caller or permissionless condition is stated; the scenario concerns the legitimate user's own first claim.
